scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/server
scripts.format: prettier --write apps docs scripts tests *.json *.yml *.ts README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps docs scripts tests *.json *.yml *.ts README.md
